abilities.name: sand-veil
abilities.effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

abilities.name: sand-rush
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

kanto.flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for prey.

original-johto.flavorText: It prefers dry, sandy places because it uses the sand to protect itself when threatened.

hoenn.flavorText: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

updated-johto.flavorText: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

original-unova.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

updated-unova.flavorText: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

kalos.flavorText: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Sandshrew has a very dry hide that is extremely tough. The Pokémon can roll into a ball that repels any attack. At night, it burrows into the desert sand to sleep.

original-alola.flavorText: It usually makes its home in deserts and arid zones, where rain does not fall. It digs holes to catch Bug-type Pokémon.

updated-alola.flavorText: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.

swsh.flavorText: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

freeTextEntries: Grand Underground - Spacious Cave, Rocky Cave, Sandsear Cave, Big Bluff Cavern (After obtaining the National Pokédex) (Kantonian Form) | Unobtainable (Alolan Form)
